Nairobi central business district at night

Michezomeans games in Swahili. Games are our whole business.

Michezo Experience (K) Ltd is a sports agency based in Nairobi. We work with clubs, federations, venues, sponsors and broadcasters to plan, fund and deliver sporting events that meet international standards.

We hold ourselves to the standards of the organisations we work with. Clear terms, clean numbers and no surprises for anyone at the table.

What we do

Sports agency services

One team handling every part of a major sporting event, working with specialist partners where they do it best.

Promotion

Sports event promotion

We originate, fund and promote matches, tournaments and stadium events, and take them from idea to sold-out night.

Partnerships

Club and federation partnerships

We negotiate and manage the agreements that bring international teams and competitions to Kenya.

Commercial

Sponsorship and brand partnerships

Title rights, official partner packages and activations, designed around audiences brands can measure.

Hospitality

Hospitality and premium experiences

Suites, corporate boxes and guest programmes that let partners host clients at the biggest moments.

Media

Media and broadcast

Broadcast, streaming and media rights arranged so every event reaches audiences well beyond the stadium.

Operations

Match and venue operations

Permits, security planning, team logistics, ticketing and match-day delivery, run to international standards.

How we work

From first call to final whistle

  1. i.

    Plan

    We agree the event, the budget and who is responsible for what, in writing, before anything is committed.

  2. ii.

    Partner

    We bring in the clubs, venue, sponsors and broadcasters, each on clear terms.

  3. iii.

    Deliver

    Our team runs permits, logistics, ticketing and match day, with partners kept informed throughout.

  4. iv.

    Report

    Every partner gets a full report on attendance, reach and what their money delivered.
